name: S.T. Bus Pass Fee Concession Scheme For Government/ Non Government Primary, Secondary & Higher Secondary and Higher Technical Education Students
benefit: Concession in Fees of the Buses of Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation (GSRTC).
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must be a Student. - The applicant must be a Girl. - The applicant must be studying in Primary / Secondary / Higher Secondary / Higher Secondary Technical Education. - The applicant must be studying in a Government or Non-Government School.
